international.title: Pete Hegseth defiant in wake of Republican’s impeachment effort as House prepares for key vote – US politics live

We sank the boats carrying poison into our communities. We put a narco dictator in handcuffs. These are not high crimes. This is the job, and it’s the job well done.” Continue reading...
